brief: Dry-run fixture: what can a Kenyan builder show from real evidence this week?

findings.finding: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE finding: short-form build logs get more completion when the artifact appears in the first two seconds
findings.suggested_use: Lead the TikTok derivative with the terminal or badge, not a talking head

findings.finding: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE finding: school administrators ask about timetable clashes before features
findings.suggested_use: FMT-03 angle: start from the timetable clash, end with the demo

findings.finding: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE finding: verifying a claim takes one click when the commit link is included
findings.suggested_use: FMT-02 episode: an import is not a workflow run

gaps: No public data on Kenyan school software budgets was found; do not claim one.
